title: Marketing Coordinator
salary_text: £35000 per year (+ Hybrid (part of the week))
description:
GBR Recruitment Ltd are delighted to working exclusively with a leading design, manufacturing & installation business based between Leicester & Derby, recruiting for an experienced Marketing Coordinator who is really strong in using HubSpot / AI tools for managing all marketing activities across the business.

The key focus for this Marketing Coordination role is utilising HubSpot to its full potential to help reach those audiences the client wants to capture in order to secure new sales.

You will update & manage HubSpot in terms of the stored data, segmentation of sales targets, campaign records, workflows for marketing, campaign preparation & delivery, drafting marketing collateral with AI tools, produce landing pages & more.

You will also get the chance to be creative developing marketing campaign ideas that are innovative & eye catching, plus managing social media channels such as X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, Facebook & LinkedIn.

You will also coordinate videography & photography activities promoting the works the business carries out & producing previous installation case studies.

Traditional marketing activities will also be undertaken in the form of graphics, brochures, POS stands, digital assets & more.

HubSpot, data & AI tasks (large % of the role, key focus on this):
- Maintain and Manage HubSpot for marketing, keeping contact data, audience segments and campaign records accurate and up to date.
- Develop and maintain marketing workflows across email campaigns, event follow-ups and nurturing contacts who have shown interest in the companies products / solutions.
- Set up and manage AI agents to support recurring marketing tasks.
- Use AI to draft and tailor marketing emails for different sectors.
- Reviewing marketing copy for accuracy and ensuring the brand tone of voice is correct and in line with other marketing activity, before it goes live to the open markets.
- Keep up to date all marketing forms and landing pages in HubSpot so enquiries can be tracked back to the campaigns that generated them.
- Produce reports showing campaign performance levels, including email engagement, enquiries and conversion rates, and use the findings to improve future campaigns.

Creative Campaigns & Social Media Activities (smaller % of the role)
- Create innovative marketing campaign ideas across industrial, commercial and other sectors the company supplies into.
- Successfully manage the social media calendar, writing and scheduling posts for LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
- Book in and oversee all customer sites photography, filming and customer interviews, turning completed projects into case studies, testimonials and short videos.
- Produce all branded graphics, brochures and associated digital assets that show how customers use the companies products.

The Marketing Coordinator role is commutable from areas such as Castle Donington, Ashby de la Zouch, Swadlincote, Derby, Burton on Trent & Coalville, plus areas close to these.

The role will be a mix of office based & hybrid working (flex).

This position could suit someone working as a Marketing Coordinator, Marketing Administrator, Marketing Executive, Marketing Associate, Marketing & Events Coordinator, HubSpot Admin & Email Marketing Specialist, HubSpot Administrator, HubSpot Coordinator, CRM Coordinator, or similar roles to these in Marketing.

The client is looking to hire ASAP, so if you are based within a commutable distance of Derby & Leicester (ideally somewhere in between the 2 locations) then apply today!
